title: Conduvera GateSkipReason (release D8_GATE_PROTOCOL)
description: Typed reason for NOT executing a planned gate. Skipping is never silent: a skip always carries a typed code plus a mandatory human-readable detail. Unknown codes fail closed at validation.

code.description: NOT_APPLICABLE_CHANGED_PATHS: candidate diff irrelevant; ASSURANCE_CLASS_MISMATCH: available result is from a different assurance class; CACHE_HIT: reusable execution with identical key; POLICY_DISABLED: policy disabled this gate; DEPENDENCY_FAILED: a depends_on gate failed; P0_P1_BLOCK: cheap early phase failed so expensive phases are not started; NON_QUALIFYING_CHANGE: change does not qualify (e.g. docs-only skips semantic review); ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE: required environment/toolchain unavailable; EXCLUDED_BY_POLICY: explicitly excluded by policy (excludable gates only).

detail.description: Mandatory explanation; empty detail would be a silent skip and is forbidden.

execution_key.description: Optional binding to the skipped/cached execution key.
